    "Part of Speech": "phrasal verb (informal)",
    "Definition": "To take or steal something and leave/escape with it, often quickly or secretly.",

    "Example Sentence": "Someone made off with my umbrella while I was inside.",
    "Note(s)": "Productive pattern includes object: make off with something.     "Definition": "Lack of courage in the face of danger, difficulty, or responsibility.",

    "Example Sentence": "He was accused of cowardice for abandoning the others.",

Keep this card for the abstract noun because the bookmark explicitly compares the two.\n\nThat's cowardice.\nBacking down now would be cowardice.\nThey are cowardice.\n\nはダメ。cowardice は名詞なので、人を述語で形容するなら They are cowardly.。一番すっきりするのは、\n\nTheir reversal exposed their cowardice.\n\ncowardice nature は不自然で、言うなら cowardly natureや、cowardly behavior",

  "5578": {

    "Word": "overwrought",
    "IPA": "/ˌoʊvərˈrɔːt/",
    "Part of Speech": "adjective",
    "Definition": "Too emotional, agitated, elaborate, or excessively worked-up in style or expression.",
    "Synonym(s)": "overemotional, overexcited, overblown",
    "Example Sentence": "The final speech felt overwrought compared with the rest of the film.",
    "Note(s)": "Can describe a person emotionally, or writing/art that feels overdone and excessively elaborate.\n\nやりすぎてガチガチ/ 感情的にいっぱいいっぱい\n\n*人・精神状態 → emotionally worked up / agitated / overwhelmed\n    「もういっぱいいっぱい」「取り乱す寸前」「神経が張り詰めてる」\n* 作品・表現・デザイン → too elaborate / too dramatic / trying too hard\n    「凝りすぎ」「盛りすぎ」「演出過剰」「やりすぎ」\n\nThe ending felt overwrought.→あのラスト、ちょっと盛りすぎじゃない？",

  },
  "6689": {
    "updatedAt": "2026-09-19T01:42:03.426Z",
    "Word": "ledge: synonyms and near-synonyms",
    "IPA": "/ledʒ/",
    "Part of Speech": "vocabulary contrast",
    "Definition": "Depending on context, a ledge may be a shelf, projection, sill, lip, rim, edge, or narrow shelf-like rock formation; these are not interchangeable in every setting.",
    "Synonym(s)": "shelf, projection, sill, lip, rim, edge",
    "Example Sentence": "The bird perched on a rock ledge. / Put the plant on the window ledge—or windowsill. / A tiny lip around the tray isn't normally called a ledge.",
    "Note(s)": "Search-intent card: choose by geometry/context. Shelf often supports objects; sill is architectural; lip/rim = raised/bounding edge; ledge projects horizontally from a surface/cliff.\n\n1. ledge（レッジ）最もよく使われるのは「窓枠のすぐ外・内の平らな部分（window ledge）」や「崖の途中にある岩棚（cliff ledge）」です。例文: He placed a small flower pot on the window ledge.訳: 彼は窓の棚状の突き出た部分に小さな植木鉢を置いた。\n\n2. shelf（シェルフ）家具の「棚」として有名ですが、自然の地形で使う場合は ledge よりも「平らな面積が広い場所」を指します。例文: The climbers rested on a narrow rock shelf.訳: 登山家たちは狭い岩棚の上で休憩した。\n\n3. ridge（リッジ）「細長い隆起」を指すため、平らなスペースというよりは、山の頂上へと続く細い道（尾根）や、地形の尖った境界線を指します。例文: We walked along the mountain ridge.訳: 私たちは山の尾根に沿って歩いた。\n\n4. projection（プロジェクション）建築や地質学の専門用語に近い、非常に客観的な言葉です。「飛び出しているもの」全般を指します。例文: Watch your head on that concrete projection.訳: あのコンクリートの突起物に頭をぶつけないよう気をつけて。\n\n5. lip（リップ）「唇」から転じて、何かの容器や崖の「一番端のキワ」を指します。例文: She stood at the lip of the crater.訳: 彼女は火口の縁（ふち）に立った。",
    "Category": "",
    "Source": "voca_0110–0121 | folders: voca_0120 | search: ledge synonym",
    "__noteLineBreaks": true
  },
  "6884": {
    "updatedAt": "2026-09-23T14:57:43.287Z",
    "Word": "provocation",
    "IPA": "/ˌprɑːvəˈkeɪʃən/",
    "Part of Speech": "noun",
    "Definition": "An act, statement, event, or stimulus that provokes a reaction—especially anger, conflict, retaliation, or a response; also the act of provoking.",
    "Synonym(s)": "incitement, goading, trigger, stimulus, challenge",
    "Example Sentence": "He refused to respond to the provocation. / The attack was described as a deliberate provocation.",
    "Note(s)": "Can be interpersonal, political/military, legal, or general. 'Without provocation' = without being provoked. Legal significance varies by jurisdiction.\n\nTypical situations: A deliberate insult meant to make someone react; a player taunting or shoving an opponent to draw retaliation; a political statement intended to anger another country; a threatening military maneuver likely to trigger a response.\n\nA player shoves an opponent after the whistle, hoping to make him retaliate. The opponent refused to respond to the provocation and kept his composure.\n\nA politician deliberately makes a statement he knows will anger the neighboring country and force a response.\n\nsports: 相手を反応させるためのshove / taunt\npolitics/diplomacy: 相手国が反発すると分かっている発言や象徴的行動\nmilitary: 国境付近での威圧的な接近や演習\ninterpersonal: わざと侮辱したり挑発的なことを言って反応を引き出す\nprovocation = 挑発、刺激、反応を引き起こすもの\n\nMore Synonyms:\n\nIncitement (causing a reaction or anger): Incitement, Instigation, Goading, Aggravation\nAnnoyance (causing irritation): Vexation, Irritation, Harassment, Affront\nStimulus (spurring action or motivation): Stimulus, Incentive, Inducement, Impetus",
    "Category": "",
    "Source": "voca_0110–0121 | folders: voca_0121 | search: provocation",
    "__noteLineBreaks": true
  }

      "content": {
        "senseHook": "「一任する」、「委ねる」\nビジネスシーンで相手や前後の文脈に合わせての使い分け表現：\n一任する: 判断や処置をすべて相手に任せること。「〇〇さんに一任します」\n委ねる: 判断や処置を相手に任せること。「判断を委ねます」\n譲る: 自分の意見や立場を引っ込めて、相手の意見や判断に合わせること。「〇〇さんに譲ります」\n拝聴する / 従う: 「〇〇さんの意見に従います」と言いたいとき。\n\n「yield to someone（相手に譲る）」や「let someone decide（人に決めさせる）」",

      "content": {
        "senseHook": "「一任する」、「委ねる」\nビジネスシーンで相手や前後の文脈に合わせての使い分け表現：\n一任する: 判断や処置をすべて相手に任せること。「〇〇さんに一任します」\n委ねる: 判断や処置を相手に任せること。「判断を委ねます」\n譲る: 自分の意見や立場を引っ込めて、相手の意見や判断に合わせること。「〇〇さんに譲ります」\n拝聴する / 従う: 「〇〇さんの意見に従います」と言いたいとき。\n\n「yield to someone（相手に譲る）」や「let someone decide（人に決めさせる）」",
